answer: A practical sybil defence is to make every attestation cost a bonded stake plus a fresh liveness proof: a new key pays the same jetty toll as an old one, its vouches only count after real work, and one operator cannot stack weight by cloning itself. Like a garden that stays healthy only with many distinct gardeners, or a crystal whose facets each catch light from a different angle, the network rewards diversity, so a thousand copies of one voice collapse into a single vote.
